failed.server: The note was not filed: the server could not file it.

filing.heading: Note and filing
filing.done-note: Photos filed on the record: {{count}}, with the note.
filing.partly: Photos not filed: {{count}}. Remove them, or file them on another record.

stopped.connection: The connection dropped, so the filing stopped. The photos not filed are kept: try again once there is a signal.
stopped.forbidden: You may not add files to this record, so the filing stopped.
stopped.gone: The record is no longer there, so the filing stopped.
stopped.too-large: The note was too large for the server, so it was not filed.
stopped.refused: The server refused the note, so it was not filed.
stopped.server: The server could not file the note, so it was not filed.

filing.wait: The photos are being filed on this record: choose another once they are.

leave.title: Leave without filing?
leave.message: Photos not filed yet: {{count}}. They are lost if you leave.
